scope: Scarlet Invocation Act signature moves: CinderCurtain (17, Act I), ShroudRope (18, Act II) and FourHands (19, Act III) replace the four basic notes of every third phrase (serial % 3 == 0) of Acts I-III; the seal crossflow stays the fifth note and Final is unchanged. Geometry lives in the Terraria-free CrimsonSignatureMoves and is shared by forecast, drawing and native collision. Damage stays at the rehearsal 1. No motions or new art
target_build: 0.3.68 / protocol79 (feat/scarlet-signature-moves, stacked on feat/scarlet-music-grid; protocol 78 is the music-grid integration)

implementation_decisions.four_hands_pair_order: the design's list {0,2} {1,3} {0,3} {1,2} leaves the safe quarters of beats 0/1 and 2/3 disjoint, contradicting its own rule that consecutive beats share a safe quarter. The same four pairs are ordered {0,2} {0,3} {1,3} {1,2} (safe {1,3} {1,2} {0,2} {0,3}); rotation by serial/3 % 4 is a label bijection so the rule holds for every rotation
implementation_decisions.four_hands_claws_upright: a 40 px hook leaves a 37 px nook at each quarter edge (74 px between two slammed neighbours, a player fits) or crosses the +/-8 px quarter fence, because spacing 213 with radius 110 already fills +/-323 px; the claws stay upright and form one solid slab
implementation_decisions.corridor_review: review changed the corridor from two columns (512 px) to three columns (768 px, seven columns burn) and the high rope from 112 to 170 px above the floor, for fairness at base run speed and with an ordinary jump
implementation_decisions.cinder_curtain_join: the two columns touching the corridor keep radius 128 so the corridor is exactly 768 px; every other column uses 130 so blocked neighbours overlap by 2 px
implementation_decisions.cinder_curtain_direction: the observed column is the LEADING end of the first corridor: a right walk starts at o-2, a left walk at o; right on even ordinals (serial / 3), left on odd, the other way when the preferred walk does not fit columns 0..7 for all four corridors; at o = 0, 1, 8, 9 neither fits and the walk heads away from the nearer wall with its start clamped to 0 or 7 (review change: previously the observed column was the trailing end, which forced about 5.6 px per tick on a right walk)
implementation_decisions.rope_radius: constant 10 px for the whole 12-tick window (no end taper), so the live height equals the announced height
implementation_decisions.reach_ticks: curtain and hands fall over 3 ticks (smoothstep), the rope enters over 2 ticks like the spatial cuts; reach 0 emits no stroke
implementation_decisions.unaimed_target: ShroudRope and FourHands carry the field centre in Target like ChoirRakes; CinderCurtain carries the first note's member observation in all four notes
implementation_decisions.validation: signature techniques require Pulse < 4 and a live window of at most 20/12/16 ticks in CrimsonGesturePlan.Validate
implementation_decisions.sounds: existing beam cue mapping; the rope uses the slash cues (ChargeLock/ChargeRush), the curtain and hands the default PortalFire

measured_properties.curtain_corridor: exactly 768 px free (scanned at 0.25 px steps at three heights for all eight corridor positions on two fields); every other point burns; 20x42 bodies fit anywhere in the corridor and one pixel into either wall burns
measured_properties.curtain_walk: one column per beat in one direction away from the observed column; the observed player's column is free for notes 0-2 at columns 2-7, notes 0-1 at columns 1 and 8, note 0 at columns 0 and 9 (and burns on the next note); consecutive corridors share two columns (512 px) that are free in both notes; live windows (20 ticks) end before the next fall (28-29 ticks)
measured_properties.curtain_speed: slowest constant runner found by scanning speeds at 0.05 px per tick against the real strokes, a player standing at the centre of the observed column: columns 2-7 need 1.60 px per tick when starting at note 1's warning (the direction is visible then; 1.20 when starting at note 0's), so Terraria's base run of 3 px per tick follows the whole walk (asserted); against a wall the forced walk needs 3.45 px per tick at columns 1 and 8 and 5.65 at columns 0 and 9 when starting at note 0's warning (asserted as measured bounds; these exceed 3 px per tick, a remedy would keep the corridor against the wall instead of walking away)
measured_properties.rope_heights: standing body (feet at the floor) is hit by the low cut only, with 118 px of clearance under the high cut; a rise of 37-117 px clears both, including an ordinary full jump (feet up to about 106 px); a rise of 118-180 px meets the high cut; the low cut hits up to a 36 px rise
measured_properties.hands: two quarters slammed per note, every quarter slammed twice and spared twice per phrase, consecutive beats share a safe quarter in every rotation, slabs are solid (no nook) and stay within 8 px of their quarter (3 px measured); safe quarters take a 20x42 body anywhere 8 px inside their edges

checks.domain: passed: every new case (selection cadence 3/6/9/12 and IDs, curtain corridor and walk and follow simulation, rope heights, hands quarters, composition/codec rejections) plus the changed technique cases; the cases fail when the corridor join, claw spacing or rope height are mutated
checks.python: passed: tools/tests, including a new wiring check for the shared geometry and the single curtain observation
checks.offline_plots: passed: .local/geometry-preview (not committed) links the production domain sources and rasterises CrimsonTechniqueGeometry.Write through CrimsonTechniqueGeometry.Intersects; inspected the right-walking, left-walking and flipped curtain, the rope with seven body heights per note, and all four rotations of the hands. Shapes, corridors, free and hit bodies matched the design. These are geometry plots, not the production materials

not_run: in-game play of any signature move, including the feel of the walking corridor (about 1.6 px per tick in the field, 3.5 to 5.7 against a wall), the rope heights with a real jump and the quarter edges
readability of the soft forecast bands over the sanctum and against the existing live material (another branch is replacing the live material)
